verdict.rationale: Expensify documents its own background automations. Reports auto-submit on a schedule, expenses are auto-categorized as they are created, reports export automatically after a daily accounting sync, and users can build rules by asking the AI. These are fixed, predefined expense-workflow automations described mostly in marketing copy, not a general-purpose user-defined automation engine; a community report of poor auto-categorization accuracy affects quality, not whether the automation runs. Missing for 10: detailed docs on configuring custom triggers and actions, user-defined schedules beyond the built-in expense workflows, and independent hands-on confirmation that automations run unattended.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
